description: The most traded US companies: names and tickers ranked by dollar volume (trading volume in US dollars) for the latest session or the last 5 or 20 sessions, top 10 by default (at most 20), each with a link to its page on InfinityVolume. Names and rank only: no prices and no per-company figures.

limit.description: How many companies. Default 10, at most 20.

window.description: Sessions the ranking covers: 1d, 5d or 20d (or a number of sessions, a week or a month). Default 1d (the latest session).

name: infinity_most_traded
title: Most traded companies
